mechanism: splice variant STIM2.1 (extra exon in the CAD/SOAR) binds Orai1 poorly, fails to gate it and lowers SOCE; it binds calmodulin more strongly
sentence: Here, Miederer et al. identify a novel splice variant of STIM2 that fails to interact with and activate Orai1 and may act to fine-tune cellular calcium homeostasis by negatively regulating calcium influx.
justification: STIM2.1 overexpression lowers SOCE and its knockdown raises SOCE in naive CD4+ T cells.

mechanism: APP loss lowers TRPC1 and Orai1 protein in astrocytes, reducing store content and SOCE
sentence: This reflected a downregulated expression in APP KO astrocytes of TRPC1 (C-type transient receptor potential) and Orai1 proteins, essential components of store-operated channels (SOCs).
justification: APP knockout and APP siRNA reduce TRPC1 protein. Context: cortical astrocytes.

mechanism: APP loss lowers TRPC1 and Orai1 protein in astrocytes, reducing store content and SOCE
sentence: This reflected a downregulated expression in APP KO astrocytes of TRPC1 (C-type transient receptor potential) and Orai1 proteins, essential components of store-operated channels (SOCs).
justification: APP knockout reduces ORAI1 protein; Orai1 siRNA reproduces the SOCE loss.

mechanism: ZDHHC20 S-acylates ORAI1 at Cys143, targeting it to cholesterol-rich rafts and the immune synapse; acylation-deficient ORAI1 gives less SOCE, NFATC1 translocation and IL-2
sentence: S-acylation by ZDHHC20 targets ORAI1 channels to lipid rafts for efficient Ca2+ signaling by Jurkat T cell receptors at the immune synapse
justification: ZDHHC20 expression drives ORAI1 S-acylation and raft partitioning; C143 mutants lose function. Context: HEK-293 and Jurkat T cells.

mechanism: ST6GAL1 adds alpha-2,6 sialic acid to the Orai1 N-glycan (N223), which favours lectin (Siglec) binding and attenuates SOCE
sentence: Knockdown of the sialyltransferase ST6GAL1 reduced alpha-2,6-linked sialic acids in the glycan structure of Orai1 and was associated with increased Ca(2+) entry in Jurkat T cells.
justification: ST6GAL1 knockdown raises Ca2+ entry; the N223A glycan mutant also enhances SOCE.

mechanism: long isoform STIM1L preferentially binds TRPC1 and TRPC4 after store depletion, for fast store refilling and myogenesis
sentence: Upon store depletion, TRPC1 and TRPC4 appeared to interact preferentially with STIM1L compared to STIM1.
justification: Co-IP of TRPC1/TRPC4 with STIM1L in human myotubes; knockdown of TRPC1/4 mimics STIM1L loss.

mechanism: long isoform STIM1L preferentially binds TRPC1 and TRPC4 after store depletion
sentence: Upon store depletion, TRPC1 and TRPC4 appeared to interact preferentially with STIM1L compared to STIM1.
justification: Co-IP of TRPC1 with STIM1L in human myotubes.

mechanism: mannan-binding lectin binds PDK1 and promotes its ubiquitination, dampening PDK1-SGK1 signalling and thereby promoting Orai1 ubiquitination, lowering SOCE and EMT
sentence: It was further demonstrated that MBL promoted the ubiquitination of Orai1, an essential component of SOCE, via pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase 1 (PDK1)-serum glucocorticoid-regulated kinase 1 signaling.
justification: MBL increases Orai1 ubiquitination; PDK1 inhibition abolishes MBL's effect on SOCE. MBL-/- mice show worse fibrosis. Context: lung epithelial cells.

mechanism: sigma-1 receptor blocks TRPC1-mediated store-dependent Ca2+ entry (no direct binding), associating with STIM1 at rest; its loss protects dopaminergic cells
sentence: Importantly, sigma 1 receptor inhibited TRPC1-mediated Ca2+ entry and silencing of sigma 1 receptor significantly restored store-dependent Ca2+ influx.
justification: Sigma1R silencing restores TRPC1-mediated SOCE. Context: dopaminergic neuronal cells.

mechanism: sigma-1 receptor associates with STIM1; store depletion decreases the association
sentence: Although co-immunoprecipitation failed to show an interaction between the TRPC1 and sigma 1 receptor, store depletion promoted a decrease in the sigma 1 receptor-STIM1 association.
justification: Co-IP shows sigma1R-STIM1 association that drops on store depletion.

mechanism: pharmacological JAK2 inhibition (TG101348, AG490) lowers Orai1 and STIM1 protein and SOCE while raising NCX1
sentence: RESULTS: JAK2 inhibitor TG101348 (1 microM) decreased Orai1 and STIM1 protein abundance, increased NCX1 transcript levels, decreased Ca2+ release from intracellular stores, decreased SOCE, increased Ca2+ entry as well as Ca(2+)-current following extracellular Na(+)-removal, and decreased migration.
justification: JAK2 inhibitor reduces ORAI1 protein. Context: MCF-7 cells; inhibitor only, no genetic JAK2 loss.

mechanism: pharmacological JAK2 inhibition lowers STIM1 protein and SOCE
sentence: RESULTS: JAK2 inhibitor TG101348 (1 microM) decreased Orai1 and STIM1 protein abundance, increased NCX1 transcript levels, decreased Ca2+ release from intracellular stores, decreased SOCE, increased Ca2+ entry as well as Ca(2+)-current following extracellular Na(+)-removal, and decreased migration.
justification: JAK2 inhibitor reduces STIM1 protein. Context: MCF-7 cells; inhibitor only.

mechanism: androgens via AR lower STIM1 and Orai1 and raise TMEM66 (SARAF), blunting TNF/IL-13-enhanced SOCE in airway smooth muscle
sentence: AR effects involve reduced Ca2+ influx via L-type channels and store-operated Ca2+ entry, the latter by downregulating STIM1 and Orai1 and increasing TMEM66.
justification: AR activation downregulates STIM1. Context: primary human airway smooth muscle cells.

sentence: AR effects involve reduced Ca2+ influx via L-type channels and store-operated Ca2+ entry, the latter by downregulating STIM1 and Orai1 and increasing TMEM66.
justification: AR activation downregulates ORAI1 in human ASM.

mechanism: androgens via AR raise TMEM66/SARAF, the STIM1 inhibitor, adding to SOCE suppression
sentence: AR effects involve reduced Ca2+ influx via L-type channels and store-operated Ca2+ entry, the latter by downregulating STIM1 and Orai1 and increasing TMEM66.
justification: AR activation increases SARAF (TMEM66) in human ASM.
